Carolynn Dubé, executive director of Fertility Matters Canada, with her three sons and husband Bryan. Originally a Coté from North Sydney, Dubé became involved in fertility advocacy, education and awareness after becoming a mom to three boys through in vitro fertilization treatment. The couple's sons, pictured here, are seven-year-old Bren and two-year-old twins Shae, in his mother's arms, and Theo, in his dad's. CONTRIBUTED
